title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern
text:
Machine Learning Engineer Intern (Summer 2027)

About the role
You will join a small applied team that builds models for document understanding and customer analytics. You will train, evaluate and ship models used by internal teams.

Responsibilities
- Build and evaluate machine learning models on large tabular and text datasets
- Write production-quality Python and SQL
- Package models with Docker and deploy them to AWS
- Communicate results to engineers and product managers

Required qualifications
- Pursuing a B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related field, graduating between December 2026 and June 2028
- Strong Python programming skills
- Coursework or project experience in machine learning
- Experience with SQL
- Familiarity with Git

Preferred qualifications
- Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow
- Experience with natural language processing
- Exposure to AWS and Docker
- Knowledge of statistics

This role requires work authorization in the United States; we are unable to sponsor visas for this internship.
